title: Dune Allen – Sea La Vie Santa Rosa Beach, Florida 30A Vacay
description_expanded: OverviewBRAND NEW LISTING: Community Pool-Golf Cart Option-Free Beach Bikes-Public BeachThe Space✨QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: ✔ Fully Stocked Kitchen- Perfect for cooking your favorite meal ✔ Two Primary Suites – 1st-floor suite + upstairs suite for flexibility ✔ Corner Lot Privacy – Peaceful setting near Dune Allen Beach ✔ Screened-In 2nd-Floor Patio – Relax and enjoy tranquil views ✔ Fenced Backyard – Ideal for outdoor entertaining ✔ 4 Adult Beach Cruiser Bikes 🏠 Welcome to Sea La Vie: Experience the perfect combination of luxury, comfort, and sustainability at Beat Navy House — ideally located just minutes from the sugar-white sands of Dune Allen Beach. Nestled on a private corner lot, this beautifully designed 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath coastal retreat delivers the ultimate 30A lifestyle. The open-concept main level is perfect for entertaining, featuring a chef’s kitchen with quartz countertops, abundant cabinetry, and generous prep space. Flow seamlessly into the spacious family room or step outside to the peaceful outdoor patio, perfect for morning coffee or evening cocktails under the stars. Enjoy the convenience of two primary suites, including one on the first floor. Head upstairs where you’ll find three bedrooms, two full baths, and a screened-in covered patio overlooking the natural surroundings. Just minutes away, the newly renovated Dune Allen Regional Beach Access offers restrooms, outdoor showers, and plenty of parking—making your beach days effortless. 🌊 AREA ATTRACTIONS – Dune Allen Beach: This beach neighborhood boasts three coastal dune lakes, which are extremely rare bodies of water found in only a handful of places across the world. Dune Allen also offers more than five miles of breathtaking trails in Topsail Hill Preserve State Park — making it a dream destination for nature lovers and ecosplorers. Come unwind and relax in the most inspiring type of setting. Start each day with a walk along the sugar-white sand; then, rent a bike and pedal your way along the Timpoochee Trail. Any Dune Allen visitor must make a stop along the Oyster Lake bridge — this stunning walkway is the perfect backdrop for a South Walton family photo. At the end of the day, kick back and enjoy live music and fresh seafood at Stinky’s Fish Camp. A South Walton favorite for nearly a decade, this restaurant was recently named as one of the Top 10 Places to Eat Like a Local by USA Today. Sleeping Arrangements: 1st Floor Queen Bed - Private Bathroom 2nd Floor Queen Bed - Shared Bathroom 2 Twin Beds - Shared Bathroom King Bed - Private BathroomShow less
